latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Instantly generate 1080p videos from text prompts with no duration or render limits.
- Upload TXT, DOCX, PDF, or SRT files (up to 500MB) for video creation—no local installation needed.
- Supports automatic session setup, including free token generation for new users.
- Cloud GPU pipeline delivers ready-to-share MP4s, with typical renders in 1–3 minutes.
- All major video and audio formats supported for export.
- Usage actions like generate, export, check credits, and upload are mapped directly to intuitive prompts.
